title: Samsung Galaxy S25 256GB $729 Delivered + S26U $1400 + S26FE 700 + MORE @ Phonex AU
body:
Deal: Samsung Galaxy S25 256GB $729 Delivered + S26U $1400 + S26FE 700 + MORE @ Phonex AU

[Mokr] How is an almost two years Samsung phone not under 600 yet
[fruxo] I didn't post a deal, but the s25 is on sale from the Samsung store as well. The exact price depends on your vouchers and whether you can access the education store. Might be worth checking what price you can get if you are interested.
Anyway, I bought it today for $607 on the education store by stacking GALAXYBOOST (-$100), black Friday voucher (-$50), birthday voucher (-$50) and 5% first purchase.
Edit: and s26 fe is actually VERY well priced at $689 before vouchers. Too big for me but technically a better bargain for people that don't mind the size.
